items.title: For K in the derived category of the small etale topos of a scheme S the adjunction K -> R pi_* pi^{-1} K is an isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records that cohomological descent is automatic for the small etale topos of a scheme (statement lines 21307-21314). The proof (proof lines 21316-21320) is two sentences: both pi_S^{-1} and pi_{S,*} = i_S^{-1} are exact functors, and their composition is the identity, so the adjunction map is an isomorphism objectwise even without deriving. H2: the argument is the direct observation that the two functors are exact and compose to the identity.
